text: Bună seara, sorry to message so late, maybe it's nothing. My son is 7 months, temperature 39.2. His eczema is flaring up again, dry itchy patches on his cheeks and behind the knees, he keeps rubbing them. And I panicked a bit because his lips went blue, but his sister gave him a lick of her blue ice lolly, the colour wiped straight off with a cloth and his tongue is blue too lol. The rest of him looks normal, normal colour. Doamne, I'm sorry, I just want to know if the fever is too high for a baby this little.
